title: 10th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/10/2024).
Bills to be introduced: first reading of the bill to amend the Copyright and Related Rights Act (Law No. 23/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Nilandhoo MP Fathimath Saudha.

From the Speaker's desk: under Article 6(3) of the MMA Act (Law No. 6/81), the matter of advising the President on removing Maldives Monetary Authority Governor Ali Hashim from office is sent to the relevant standing committee, as provided in Standing Order 210(b).
Preliminary debate on the resolution submitted by Baarah MP Ibrahim Shujau to ascertain how members of the 20th Majlis view the number of MPs increasing every five years.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the Public Debt Bill (bill on state debt), submitted on behalf of the government by Funadhoo MP Mohamed Mamdhooh.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the Fiscal Responsibility Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Thulusdhoo MP Ibrahim Naseem.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting introduced the Copyright Act amendment, sent the removal of MMA Governor Ali Hashim to committee, opened debate on the MP-numbers resolution, and continued the Public Debt and Fiscal Responsibility bills.
